title: Intestinal Microbiota in Stem Cell Transplant Transplant Admission
official: Intestinal Microbiota Alteration by Antibiotics Used During Stem Cell Transplant Admission
summary: In this prospective study, the primary objective will be to investigate the association between the use of antibiotics administered during the admission period of Stem cell transplant (SCT) and the rate of overall change in microbiota composition across adjacent samples in time.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged 18-80 years
* patients undergoing allogenic or autologous SCT for malignant hematological conditions or bone marrow failure
